description: This Java class functions as a REST controller named BookImportController, responsible for handling HTTP POST requests to import book data from LibraryThing using multipart form data. It processes uploaded JSON files to facilitate data import operations within the book project.

classes.name: BookImportController
classes.description: A REST controller that provides an endpoint for importing book data from LibraryThing JSON files.

methods.name: importFromLibraryThing
methods.description: Handles the POST request to upload a multipart form file, deserializes the JSON content into a HashMap, wraps it into a data import object, and delegates the import process to a service.
